known_exclusion: BraTS-TCGA test-set data availability is outside this crosswalk.

normalization_rules.UCSF-PDGM: Prefix UCSF-PDGM- and zero-pad the numeric portal value to four digits.
normalization_rules.UPENN-GBM: Remove the trailing underscore study suffix from the portal value.
normalization_rules.additional_private_or_unnamed_groups: Retain the BraTS challenge ID without asserting a source Collection.
normalization_rules.numeric_test_rows: Normalize the eight workbook-only numeric forms to the existing BraTS2021_ five-digit alias; do not assert a TCGA source link.
